lines.speaker: eunhwa
lines.text: Hey, Weakling.
Eunhwa? What a surprise.

lines.speaker: eunhwa
lines.text: Ugh,

lines.speaker: eunhwa
lines.text: I knew I'd regret sending you a message.
You should be honest with your feelings now.

lines.speaker: eunhwa
lines.text: You're on thin ice, Weakling.

lines.speaker: eunhwa
lines.text: My sniper rifle

lines.speaker: eunhwa
lines.text: can penetrate through many barriers and travel vast distances.

lines.speaker: eunhwa
lines.text: I suggest you hold your tongue.
Hehe. Anyway, what was it you had to say?

lines.speaker: eunhwa
lines.text: Tsk.

lines.speaker: eunhwa
lines.text: I heard something strange from Emma.

lines.speaker: eunhwa
lines.text: She said that if you frown every day,

lines.speaker: eunhwa
lines.text: misfortune will befall you, and you'll also get wrinkles.
That sounds something like what Emma would say.

lines.speaker: eunhwa
lines.text: Ha!

lines.speaker: eunhwa
lines.text: If I were to heed her advice, I'd find myself parading around with a moronic smile plastered on my face

lines.speaker: eunhwa
lines.text: like that soda-obsessed ignoramus from the Counters,

lines.speaker: eunhwa
lines.text: or that self-proclaimed hero in Matis.

lines.speaker: eunhwa
lines.text: Do you think that's possible?
They do say that smiling brings good luck and helps prevent wrinkles.

lines.speaker: eunhwa
lines.text: ... What utter nonsense!

lines.speaker: eunhwa
lines.text: Just listening to drivel like that,

lines.speaker: eunhwa
lines.text: I'll be as dumb as you before long.
I just want to see your smile.

lines.speaker: eunhwa
lines.text: The moment I became a Nikke,

lines.speaker: eunhwa
lines.text: laughter became a thing of the past.

lines.speaker: eunhwa
lines.text: I don't do smiles.
I believe what Emma meant is that you just need to loosen up a bit.
You don't have to force yourself to smile all the time, but...

lines.speaker: eunhwa
lines.text: Uh-huh?
It's not good to be so hard on yourself all the time.

lines.speaker: eunhwa
lines.text: Weakling,

lines.speaker: eunhwa
lines.text: you may be a third-rate Commander who's beyond saving,

lines.speaker: eunhwa
lines.text: but even you sometimes manage to say something meaningful.

lines.speaker: eunhwa
lines.text: You're still a far cry from Vesti, though.
I'm glad I was able to comfort you.

lines.speaker: eunhwa
lines.text: Tsk.

lines.speaker: eunhwa
lines.text: Don't get a big head about it.

lines.speaker: eunhwa
lines.text: Even a broken clock is right twice a day.
